classes.summary: Produces instances by Transformation of a basic item.

instanceMethods.name: Compute
instanceMethods.signature: (Origin: StepGeom_Axis2Placement3d, Target: StepGeom_Axis2Placement3d, theLocalFactors: StepData_Factors): boolean
instanceMethods.comment: Computes a transformation to pass from an Origin placement to a Target placement. Returns True when done If not done, the transformation will by Identity.

instanceMethods.name: Compute
instanceMethods.comment: Computes a transformation defined by an operator 3D.

instanceMethods.name: Transformation
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the computed transformation (Identity if not yet or if failed).

instanceMethods.name: Transform
instanceMethods.comment:
Applies the computed transformation to a shape Returns False if the transformation is Identity.
@param shape Mutated in place; read the updated value from this argument after the call.

instanceMethods.name: TranslateMappedItem
instanceMethods.signature: (mapit: StepRepr_MappedItem, TP: Transfer_TransientProcess, theLocalFactors?: StepData_Factors, theProgress?: Message_ProgressRange): TopoDS_Shape
instanceMethods.comment:
Translates a MappedItem. More precisely A MappedItem has a MappingSource and a MappingTarget MappingSource has a MappedRepresentation and a MappingOrigin MappedRepresentation is the basic item to be instanced MappingOrigin is the starting placement MappingTarget is the final placement.
Hence, the transformation from MappingOrigin and MappingTarget is computed, the MappedRepr. is converted to a Shape, then transformed as an instance of this Shape

classes.name: StepToTopoDS_TranslateCompositeCurve
classes.summary: Translate STEP entity composite_curve to {@link TopoDS_Wire | `TopoDS_Wire`} If surface is given, the curve is assumed to lie on that surface and in case if any segment of it is a curve_on_surface, the pcurve for that segment will be taken. Note: a segment of composite_curve may be itself composite_curve. Only one-level protection against cyclic references is implemented.
